summary: Russian forces struck civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv, Odesa, and Dnipropetrovsk regions with drones and guided bombs, causing deaths and injuries. Ukrainian air defenses reported at least two shootdowns and one or two hits amid ballistic and cruise missile threats. Russian MoD claimed strikes on dry cargo ships in Mykolaiv port and destruction of two Ukrainian uncrewed boats in the Black Sea.
key_points: Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv, Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions with deaths and wounded reported (Source: @UkraineNow/82727).
Three Kh-59 missiles were reported heading toward Odesa according to a Ukrainian monitoring channel (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69096).
Russian MoD stated VSRF hit four dry cargo ships unloading cargo for VSU in Mykolaiv port (Source: @tass_agency/385712).
VSRF destroyed two uncrewed boats of VSU in Black Sea and Yegorlytsky Gulf using Lancets per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385711).
A guided aerial bomb strike on Izium, Kharkiv region, wounded five including three children and caused a 200 sq m fire (Source: @UkraineNow/82733).
A massive drone attack on a Naftogaz gas extraction site in Kharkiv region halted operations; it was the 250th attack this year (Source: @UkraineNow/82721).
Nearly 40 drone and guided bomb attacks hit Dnipropetrovsk region, damaging a logistics warehouse and housing, wounding ten (Source: @UkraineNow/82731).
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region was warned by a Ukrainian monitor (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69117).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv, Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions with drones and guided bombs causing deaths and injuries. Ukrainian monitors reported Kh-59 missiles on Odesa, ballistic threats from Bryansk, and at least two shootdowns with one or two hits. Russian MoD claimed strikes on four dry cargo ships in Mykolaiv port and destruction of two Ukrainian uncrewed boats in the Black Sea and Yegorlytsky Gulf.

points: Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure on Kharkivshchyna, in Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions with deaths and wounded reported, including one man's body fragments found in Kharkiv after a fire (Source: @UkraineNow/82727).
In Odesa, a nighttime Russian missile strike on a residential building killed two people and wounded five including three children per Zelensky (Source: @UkraineNow/82714).
A guided aerial bomb strike on Izium, Kharkiv region, wounded five including three children, destroyed and damaged homes and started a 200 sq m fire in private sector (Source: @UkraineNow/82733).

A massive drone attack on a Naftogaz gas extraction site in Kharkiv region halted operations with staff in shelters; it was the 250th attack this year with repeat strike threat (Source: @UkraineNow/82721).
Nearly 40 drone and guided bomb attacks hit Dnipropetrovsk region damaging a logistics warehouse, apartment block, buses, homes; ten people were wounded (Source: @UkraineNow/82731).
Zelensky ordered acting SBU head Yevgeny Khmar to also act as defense minister per TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385694).
Verkhovna Rada voted to appoint Serhiy Koretsky as prime minister and supported a new cabinet on July 16 per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82709).
In Bryansk region, Ukrainian forces attacked Suzemka village with Grad MLRS killing a 15-year-old girl and grandmother and injuring a resident per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Belgorod region, Krasnaya Yaruga shelling killed a woman and injured her husband; Maslova Pristan FPV hit a truck driver; Gerasimovka drone injured a woman (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Kursk region, a drone injured a local resident on a moped in Ryzhevka village, Ryilsky district per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
Explosions were heard in Engels, Saratov region, Russia during the night of July 16 per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82709).
In Lipetsk, residents of a multi-story building were evacuated due to a downed UAV per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101391).
In Bronnitsa, Moscow region, two gasoline tankers caught fire unexplainedly, spreading to streets and Gazelle parking, fire over 5,000 sq m per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101345).
Russian MoD said VSRF struck four dry cargo ships delivering cargo for VSU in Mykolaiv port and three more via Geran-4 seeker UAVs (Source: @tass_agency/385712, @tass_agency/385727).
From Kupyansk direction, reports indicate many drones in urban areas and development of offensive operations on the eastern bank of the Oskol River per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Krasny Lyman, VSRF are defending urban areas while Ukrainian forces organize counter-actions north of Redkodub per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In LNR, Ukrainian drone attacks over 24h hit a car in Schastya killing driver and two passengers; five civilians injured in settlements per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Dobropol direction, VSRF are in heavy fighting in Belitskoye per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In DNR, two people were killed and eleven civilians including an infant injured by attack drones per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
KABs were reported heading to Donetsk region and toward Dnipropetrovsk region per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68889).
In Sumy direction, infantry fighting occurred in Ulanovo, Mala Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Mogrytsa, Maryino, Nova Sech, Khoten; VSU transferring units (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Sumy direction, Shostkinsky district saw infantry fighting in Ulanovo and near Mala Sloboda; Sumy district fighting in multiple villages per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Bryansk region, Ukrainian Grad MLRS attack on Suzemka killed a 15-year-old girl and grandmother and injured a resident per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Kursk region, a drone injured a moped rider in Ryzhevka village per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Belgorod region, Krasnaya Yaruga shelling killed a woman and injured husband; Maslova Pristan FPV injured truck driver; Gerasimovka drone injured woman (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).

Chernihiv region saw reactive drone tracks toward Snovsk, Mykhailo-Kotsyubynske, Chernihiv, Korukivka, Berezna and Korop per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101379, @eRadarrua/101365, @eRadarrua/101377).
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic launches from Bryansk region was warned by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69117).
Two guided reactive Shahed drones were reported heading to Poltava per mon1tor_ua, with one circling near Poltava (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69110, @mon1tor_ua/69113).
Russian MoD stated VSRF hit four dry cargo ships unloading VSU cargo in Mykolaiv port and three more via Geran-4 seeker UAVs per TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385712, @tass_agency/385727).
VSRF destroyed two uncrewed boats of VSU in Black Sea and Yegorlytsky Gulf using Lancets per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385711).
Two UAVs were reported over sea heading to Odesa coast per eRadarrua; three Kh-59 missiles reported on Odesa per mon1tor_ua (Source: @eRadarrua/101385, @mon1tor_ua/69096).
In Zaporozhye front, positional fighting near Stepnogorsk and VSRF efforts to advance north on right flank per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In Kherson region, Ukrainian forces killed three civilians and injured three in 24h; region almost without power; VSRF use FAB on right bank (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
In occupied Crimea, verified strikes hit energy sites including Moynaki, Bakhchisaray, Zimine, PP-2 Krym, Nizhnegorsk, Nasosnaya-3 per eRadarrua (Source: @eRadarrua/101368).
Ukrainian drones were tracked from south toward Dnipro and from south toward Zaporizhzhia per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68878).
Three Kh-59 missiles were reported launched toward Odesa by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69096).
KABs were reported heading to Donetsk region and toward Dnipropetrovsk region per kpszsu (Source: @kpszsu/68889).
Threat of ballistic weapons use was declared by kpszsu; high Iskander-M threat from Bryansk warned by mon1tor_ua (Source: @kpszsu/68911, @mon1tor_ua/69117).
Ukrainian air defense reported at least two shootdowns and one or two hits overall per mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69108).
Russian MoD said Geran-4 seeker UAVs hit three dry cargo ships in Mykolaiv port and Lancets destroyed two VSU boats (Source: @tass_agency/385727, @tass_agency/385711).

Reactive drones tracked over Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk, toward Odesa coast, and Shaheds toward Poltava per eRadarrua and mon1tor_ua (Source: @eRadarrua/101379, @eRadarrua/101404, @eRadarrua/101385, @mon1tor_ua/69110).
Ballistic threat on Chornomorsk was reported by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69122).

key_developments: Russian forces attacked civilian infrastructure in Kharkiv, Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk regions with deaths and wounded, including one dead in Kharkiv and two in Odesa (Source: @UkraineNow/82727, @UkraineNow/82714).
Russian MoD claimed VSRF hit four dry cargo ships unloading VSU cargo in Mykolaiv port and three more via Geran-4 seeker UAVs (Source: @tass_agency/385712, @tass_agency/385727).
VSRF destroyed two uncrewed boats of VSU in Black Sea and Yegorlytsky Gulf using Lancets per Russian MoD (Source: @tass_agency/385711).
A massive drone attack on a Naftogaz gas site in Kharkiv region halted operations; it was the 250th attack this year (Source: @UkraineNow/82721).
Nearly 40 drone and guided bomb attacks hit Dnipropetrovsk region, damaging logistics warehouse and homes, wounding ten (Source: @UkraineNow/82731).
High threat of Iskander-M ballistic missile launches from Bryansk region was warned by mon1tor_ua (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69117).
From Kupyansk direction, many drones in urban areas and offensive development on eastern bank of Oskol River reported (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31688).
sections.threat_assessment: Russian strikes on civilian infrastructure across Kharkiv, Odesa and Dnipropetrovsk with guided bombs and missiles indicate sustained campaign against population centers and energy. Ballistic threats from Bryansk and Iskander-M warnings show missile risk to central Ukraine including Poltava and Chornomorsk. Russian claims of hits on Mykolaiv port dry cargo ships and uncrewed boats suggest targeting of maritime logistics. Ukrainian drone activity deep into Bryansk, Belgorod and Kursk with MLRS and UAVs exposes Russian rear vulnerability.
sections.regional_response: Hungarian PM Peter Magyar opened investigation into ex-foreign minister Peter Szijjarto's Russia ties without details per UkraineNow (Source: @UkraineNow/82707). Finnish war correspondent Heiskanen picketed Finland embassy in Moscow urging halt to VSU support and claimed about 20 Finnish mercenaries killed in Ukraine per TASS (Source: @tass_agency/385718, @tass_agency/385729). Zelensky announced opening of SBU and foreign intelligence archives on 20th century Volyn events and more exhumation permits for Poland direction (Source: @UkraineNow/82732). Small protests in Kyiv, Nikolaev, Lutsk, Poltava support ex-defense minister Fedorov per ukr_leaks_eng (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31699).
sections.intelligence_notes: Ukrainian monitors provide early warnings of Kh-59, Shahed, KAB and ballistic tracks enabling air defense claims of at least two shootdowns. Russian MoD statements on Mykolaiv port and Black Sea boats lack independent verification but indicate claimed interdiction of VSU supply. eRadarrua maps verified occupied Crimea energy strikes at Moynaki, Bakhchisaray, Nizhnegorsk and others degrading Russian military logistics. ukr_leaks_eng summaries cite frontline infantry fights in Sumy, LNR, DNR and Zaporozhye with unit transfers by VSU command.
